title: az boards query --project ${project} --wiql "SELECT [System.Id], [System.Title], [System.AssignedTo], [System.Tags], [System.CreatedDate] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.TeamProject] = @project AND [System.State] NOT IN ('Closed', 'Done', 'Removed') ORDER BY [System.CreatedDate] ASC" --output json
description: The project's open work items, whose number, title, assignee, tags, and creation `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:open-issues) reads and `modules/jq/forge.jq` folds with ado_issues, ado_assignees, and ado_tags; every call kit makes through forge/ado:az also carries --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors. The extension runs the query, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/wit/wiql/query-by-wiql?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1, then reads the first 1000 work items it finds with only the columns it selects, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/wit/work-items/list?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1, each a WorkItem as boards-work-item-show.schema.json gives one, and prints nothing at all when the query finds none, which kit reads as [].

System.State.description: The process template's state: Closed, Done, and Removed are closed, any other open.

System.AssignedTo.description: An IdentityRef, left out when nobody is assigned; uniqueName is the login az signs in as.

System.Tags.description: The tags, one text joined by "; ", left out when there are none.
